skill.name: imagegen
skill.description: Generate AI images through the verging.ai image generation API with prompt, model, size, quality, and image count options.
skill.summary: Generate image URLs from text prompts through the verging.ai API.
skill.author: verging-ai

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline backticks, placeholder API key text, and an error table. The confirmed issues are low-severity network disclosures: normal use sends prompts and credentials to verging.ai and returns CDN-hosted image URLs.

remediation.suggestion: Add a clear privacy note that prompts, request metadata, and generated image outputs are processed by verging.ai services.
Tell users to keep real API keys in environment variables or secret managers and never commit them to files.
Warn users to avoid direct shell interpolation of untrusted prompt text when adapting the curl example.

content.value_statement: Image teams need a direct way to create visual assets from text prompts. This skill documents verging.ai image generation requests with quality, size, model, and count options.
actual_capabilities: Documents authentication with the Authorization ApiKey header.
Shows the verging.ai image generation endpoint and request format.
Supports prompt, model, size, quality, and image count parameters.
Describes standard and HD credit costs for generated images.
Explains response fields for CDN image URLs and credits consumed.
Lists common HTTP error statuses for failed requests.
limitations: Requires a verging.ai API key and available account credits.
Sends prompts to verging.ai and returns externally hosted image URLs.
Provides API usage guidance, not a local image generation model.
Examples focus on documented parameters and default 1024x1024 output.

use_cases.title: Draft concept art
use_cases.description: Create early visual directions from short creative prompts before commissioning final artwork.

use_cases.title: Prepare campaign visuals
use_cases.description: Generate multiple image options for ads, posts, and landing page tests with controlled quality settings.

use_cases.title: Prototype image workflows
use_cases.description: Test verging.ai request parameters, credit use, and response handling before building an integration.

prompt_templates.title: Basic image request
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate one HD image of [subject] in [style]. Use verging.ai imagegen and return the image URL.

prompt_templates.title: Brand concept set
prompt_templates.scenario: Create several options for a brand task.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create three standard images for [brand] showing [product]. Use [colors] and [mood]. Return URLs and credit use.

prompt_templates.title: Controlled API request
prompt_templates.prompt: Use model [model], size [size], quality [quality], and n [count]. Generate this prompt: [detailed image prompt].

prompt_templates.title: Production variant review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for comparing generated options.
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this brief into four image prompts, generate variants, and compare the returned image links for visual direction: [brief].

output_examples.input: Generate one HD image of a futuristic city at sunset for a product launch concept.
output_examples.output: Returns a generated image link and reports that HD generation credits were used.

output_examples.input: Create three standard mascot concepts for a finance app using friendly flat illustration.
output_examples.output: Returns three image links, plus the total credits consumed for the request.

output_examples.input: Test a square product background with gpt-image-1 and standard quality.
output_examples.output: Returns a square image link suitable for review and records the selected model and quality.

best_practices: Include subject, style, mood, and intended use in each prompt.
Store API keys in environment variables or a secret manager.
Use standard quality for drafts and HD quality for final candidates.
anti_patterns: Do not place real API keys in prompts, chats, or committed files.
Do not send confidential prompt details without approval.
Do not generate many HD variants before estimating credit cost.

faq.question: Which image models does this skill document?
faq.answer: It documents DALL-E 3 and gpt-image-1 through the verging.ai API.

faq.question: Do I need a verging.ai API key?
faq.answer: Yes. Requests require an API key in the Authorization header.

faq.question: Where are generated images delivered?
faq.answer: The documented response returns CDN-hosted image URLs.

faq.question: How many images can one request generate?
faq.answer: The documented n parameter supports one to four images per request.

faq.question: Can this work without network access?
faq.answer: No. It depends on the external verging.ai image generation API.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
